## Activity

During December 2021, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 30 captures. This activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The capture total represents the examinations completed and submitted through the site’s reporting process. Activity levels should be considered alongside the quality of the submitted images and the time taken to complete grading, as these measures provide a fuller view of service performance. The results below summarise the available operational information for the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the submitted captures, 1 was recorded as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.3. The ungradable result indicates that the image could not be used for grading. The proportion is reported against the total capture activity for December 2021 and should be monitored as part of routine site-level quality review. No further interpretation is provided in this report.

## Grading

There were 5 referable results during December 2021. The median grading lag was 9 days. These figures summarise the grading outcome and the time between submission and completion of grading. Together, they provide a concise view of the site’s grading workload and turnaround for the reporting period. Further review can consider these results alongside capture activity and image quality.
